immutable_delivery_conflict: Same key + changed SHA256 -> quarantine; same key/content -> audit attempt only; distinct keys/equal hashes and zero-row deliveries retained.
assertion_key: Source namespace + canonical primary/assertion/version key; never collapse revisions to stable entity ID. Conflicting payload for immutable key -> quarantine.
snapshot_policy: Snapshots are observations, not new canonical assertion versions. Preserve observation provenance, deduplicate exact versions, retain revisions/reversals/corrections.

clocks.valid: Business-effective instant/interval; inclusive start and exclusive end
clocks.known: Preserve source-known intervals in canonical history, but derive availability-aware projection from delivered assertions; retrospective known_to is not a predictive feature or authority for an undelivered closure.
clocks.available: max(recorded_at, export_available_at, known_from if present, field-specific availability)
clocks.ingested: Observed pipeline commit timestamp, not reconstructed from historical exports
clocks.serving: Feature/state copy published successfully; live availability adds ingest, feature and serving publication times
clocks.backtest: Modeled source/export clock, not observed historical platform arrival

selection: First filter assertions by max(recorded_at,export_available_at,known_from/fieldavailability)<=decision_at and valid_from<=effective_at. For revision-style identity/grant/assignment histories select latest delivered(source-known,revision_no) per stableidentity, then check that selected version valid_to>effective_at or isopen. Never prefilter valid_to before selectinglatest or resurrect olderopen grant. Preserve canonical known_to for oracle equivalence but do not use hindsight known_to to suppress an oldversion before its replacement is delivered. Feed-specific history policy and source_reader.effective_versions define ties/corrections; assert ambiguousversions/conflicts fail.

field_rules.rule: calendar_known_at plus export visibility; deterministic holiday/calendar can be generated independently, never inherit unavailable realized observation fields
Outcome/post-outcome fields unavailable to active inpatient predictions; availability of header alone never makes a later field visible
All accepted booked slots available after scheduled start; no prospective elective booking or no-show use
Only source/export-visible events at origin; predicted adjudication/denial and downstream amounts excluded

correction: Resolve bed CORRECTION links before reducing state; preserve original/correcting assertions and separate effective and known replay. Reversals signed, never silent deletes.
money: DECIMAL and integer cents; no float summation of currency. One currency/unit per aggregation. Allocation run and finance vintage explicitly selected as-of.

reference_policy.canonical_use: Independent validation only; pipelines reconstruct from native

tests: Known_to closed before nextrevision export still retains olddeliveredversion
Expired latestdelivered grant cannot resurrect olderopen version
